question.text: The total number of isomeric linear dipeptides which can be synthesised from racemic alanine is

solution.text: Total number of isomeric linear dipeptides which can be synthesised from racemic mixture of alanine are four $(4),$ by $(R)$ type and (S) type. ($\because$ Has two chiral centres) i.e. The possible isomers are $$ (R R),(S R),(R S) \text { and }(S S) $$ Hence, total (4) isomeric linear dipeptides for alanine can be synthesised and option (d) is the correct answer.
